selection: Evenly spaced indices of lexically sorted block IDs; fixed before outcomes
justification: Engineering screening budgets fixed before this check: forward error <=10% of existing 0.01 rad/0.1 rad/s output scales; response discrepancy <=10% of CPU response RMS (absolute scaled floor 0.1); repeat noise <=1% (floor 0.01). CPU reconstruction must recover archived labels to 1e-8. These are development screens, not task-derived acceptance tolerances or formal equivalence. Negative outcomes remain negative; no automatic C or window calibration.
